def solution():
    # Define variables
    high_prices = [120, 122, 121, 119, 123, 125, 126, 127, 126, 124,
                   123, 122, 121, 120, 119, 118, 120, 121, 122, 123]
    low_prices = [115, 116, 117, 115, 118, 119, 120, 121, 122, 120,
                  119, 118, 116, 115, 114, 113, 114, 115, 116, 118]
    closing_prices = [117, 118, 119, 117, 120, 123, 124, 122, 123, 121,
                      120, 119, 118, 117, 116, 115, 118, 120, 121, 122]
    period = 14

    # Use the most recent 14-day period
    recent_highs = high_prices[-period:]
    recent_lows = low_prices[-period:]
    current_close = closing_prices[-1]

    highest_high = max(recent_highs)
    lowest_low = min(recent_lows)

    # Calculate Williams %R
    williams_r = ((highest_high - current_close) /
                  (highest_high - lowest_low)) * -100

    # Return the value rounded to two decimal places
    return round(williams_r, 2)
